questions.prompt: Why use & rather than and to combine two conditions?
choices: and wants one True or False, and a column is many
questions.explain: A column of answers cannot collapse to a single truth value, so `and` raises. `&` combines the masks elementwise, which is what you meant.

questions.prompt: Why bracket each condition when combining them?
choices: & binds tighter than the comparisons, so it would group them wrongly
questions.explain: Without brackets the expression is parsed as something you did not write, and the error message is rarely obvious.
